label: CLEAR LAB / SYNTHETIC — reproducible HOLD proof cases

cases.reason: Oracle feed stale (price-oracle) — price reference unreliable
cases.human_needed: Operator must confirm oracle freshness or switch reference before CLEAR.
Operator must accept slippage risk or wait for depth before CLEAR.

cases.reason: REFUSE TO CLASSIFY — doctor message unmatched by hygiene or fault allowlists
cases.human_needed: Operator must classify the doctor message, update allowlists, or accept HOLD.

cases.reason: Board reports all green while no running process was observed
cases.human_needed: Operator must confirm the process is running before CLEAR.

cases.reason: Board reports no fault while no running process was observed
cases.human_needed: Operator must confirm the process is running before CLEAR.

cases.reason: Board reports a fault — at least one indicator is in a fault state
cases.human_needed: Operator must resolve the reported fault before CLEAR.
